impact: `cargo make generate-openapi` fails with "package ID specification `__SERVICE_NAME__` did not match any packages" because the Makefile.toml task references the uppercase placeholder `__SERVICE_NAME__` while the actual workspace package is `__service_name__`. Because `crates/client/build.rs` panics when `../openapi.json` is absent, and the spec can only be produced by this broken task, any full workspace build/check fails — including `cargo clippy-strict`, `cargo build`, and `cargo test`. The clippy-strict alias (T-003) resolves and invokes clippy correctly; the failure is in this unrelated build prerequisite.
resolution:
Two distinct defects blocked the workspace build; both fixed.

1. Package-name mismatch: the server package/binary is `__service_name__` (snake) but several cargo invocations used the kebab `__SERVICE_NAME__`, so `cargo make generate-openapi` failed with "package ID `__SERVICE_NAME__` did not match any packages". Fixed `-p` and `target/release/<bin>` references in Makefile.toml (generate-openapi), crates/client/Makefile.toml (generate-openapi + pre-build), .github/workflows/on-push.yml (build + export), and .claude/scripts/enumerate-endpoints.sh (get_binary_path). The `-p __SERVICE_NAME__-client` references are correct (the client package legitimately uses the kebab name) and were left unchanged.

2. build.rs path bug: crates/client/build.rs read `../openapi.json`, but build scripts run with CWD = the crate dir, so that resolved to crates/openapi.json — while generate-openapi/CI/export-openapi all write the spec to the workspace root. Changed to `../../openapi.json` (crates/<service>-client -> workspace root); depth stays correct after T-020's dir rename.

Verified end-to-end: `cargo make generate-openapi` (exit 0, valid openapi.json), `cargo build --workspace` (exit 0), and a full instantiation in a throwaway copy (`init-service.sh payment-gateway`) followed by `cargo clippy --all-targets --workspace -- -D warnings` (exit 0, fully green). On the un-instantiated template, clippy-strict still emits one non_snake_case warning for the `__SERVICE_NAME__-client` crate ident — this is purely the uppercase placeholder and disappears after instantiation, so it is expected, not a defect.
title: generate-openapi task uses wrong package name (__SERVICE_NAME__ vs __service_name__), blocking workspace build
